topics.label: Lecture introduction and learning outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic frames the lecture by introducing its key themes and stating the learning outcomes regarding cancer evolution and the tumor microenvironment.

topics.label: Genetic and epigenetic drivers of clonal evolution
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore how sequential genetic mutations and transient epigenetic alterations confer selective fitness advantages to drive clonal expansion in tissues.

topics.label: Cell of origin and cancer stem cell hierarchy
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how normal stem cell properties, hierarchical tissue organization, and specific cells of origin influence tumor initiation and progression.

topics.label: Microenvironmental promotion and stromal dependence in tumor growth
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics discuss how external microenvironmental cues, chronic inflammation, and supportive stromal interactions promote and sustain malignant growth.

topics.label: Experimental and computational approaches to studying cancer evolution
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic describes the sequencing technologies, spatial profiling methods, and computational tools used to map and investigate tumor evolution in the laboratory.

topics.label: Synthesis of multifactorial cancer evolution
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic integrates the mutational, epigenetic, cell-of-origin, and microenvironmental factors that collectively drive the evolutionary process of cancer progression.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion and next session preview
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic concludes the lecture and previews the upcoming session on cancer therapies.
